top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards an original experiment that can be named: the 2018 observation of correlated insulator and superconducting states in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, at the angle singled out by the quantitative, falsifiable 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald prediction. Both halves are identifiable papers, the results have been reproduced by independent groups with transport, STM, compressibility and optical probes, and the gate-tunable device opens phenomena that could not be seen or controlled before. The unsettled pairing mechanism is not a reason to wait, but the citation should stay on the discovery of the states and acknowledge Andrei and earlier continuum-model work in the background text. P001 is a close second: mature and widely reproduced, but it leaves out Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan, and the HgTe conductance fell short of quantisation, so I cannot be absolutely sure the original work is fully credited. P003 is cleanly credited but is more a precision method than a discovery. No award is last because there are at least two mature, well-evidenced candidates.
recusal_note: None apparent from profile: no collaboration with Jarillo-Herrero, MacDonald, Bistritzer, Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye. Minor institutional notes only: Fellow of the University of Tokyo (Katori is Tokyo-based), and colleague Goran Johansson at Chalmers sits on the committee.
